column1: # Cross-cutting rule rows: authored input to the ECMA-262 census.
# Two or three tab-separated fields: <kebab name> <start locator>
# [<end locator>]. The optional third field is ruling R-P4's, added for the six
# Web IDL derived-interface bullets so their spans are disjoint.
# Present and entry-free at this pin, as section 8 of
# test/contracts/ecma262-census.contract.md requires: this standard emits zero
# `rule` rows. The nine requirement bullets of ruling R-P3 need no authored
# anchor, because the scanner finds them structurally — a `<ul>` whose

# immediately preceding `

` says the implementation must conform to the
# stated requirements — and their positional ids are guarded by the span
# digest. The generator invents no rule row.
